items.title: Lawrence Trotter Interview, 1966-01-13
items.q: Clyde Cub was arranging a little more than Houston then. Mm-hmm. And he arranged some.

ctx.x: Well, what did y'all use in the band? Did you get stock arrangements or did you use all special arrangements or what? They mixed them up.

Henry Holloway was arranger for the Sellers Stand Band. Mm-hmm. Kildee, we called. Yeah. He did all the arranging. Mm-hmm. And Clyde Cub was arranging a little more than Houston then. Mm-hmm. And he arranged some.
Is that with Robert? Robert Clark.
